## CRITICAL NOTE

**This document is not a regulatory document issued to or by Test Gamma Solvents.** It is a compilation of four different AI chatbot responses (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and CompliBoard) answering a hypothetical question about stormwater and spill containment rules for solvent storage in Hillsboro, Oregon. It contains no actual permit, certificate, policy, or record belonging to this company.

**What it is:** Informational guidance synthesizing Oregon DEQ's 1200-Z Industrial Stormwater General Permit (effective July 1, 2026) and related federal rules.

**What it proves:** Nothing about this company's actual compliance status. The document makes no reference to Test Gamma Solvents' Portland site, does not address the Portland location (instead uses Hillsboro as a hypothetical), and does not constitute any finding or determination by DEQ or any agency.

**What is missing:** The actual 1200-Z permit text, DEQ forms (NOI), SWPCP templates, EPA SPCC guidance, and confirmation of this company's SIC code and activity classification — all of which are prerequisites to determining actual permit obligations.

**How sure I am:** Very sure this document is not a compliance record for this company and should not be filed or relied upon as such. If this company operates in Portland and stores solvents outdoors, it needs its own actual permit determination from Oregon DEQ.
